pages.title: A captured essence
pages.text: “The body may perish, armor may break, and weapons may lose their edge. Yet the memory of the soul has the power to restore what has worn away.”$(br2)The Soul’s Memory gradually restores the durability of equipment, preserving it from destruction.

pages.title: Memoirs
pages.text: Memory restores the durability of armor and items held in the main hand and off-hand. Items in the gear cells of the $(l:beginning/vault)Vault$() are repaired too. Hold the artifact in either hand or place it in a vault cell.$(br2)$(#1C7FA8)Restoration:$() Using an artifact consumes its own durability. To restore it, combine a Soul Memory with a $(thing)Crystallized Soul$().
